inputs.text: They're trying to sell us this story that an estimated 8 million Americans showed up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states for these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump. The organizers are claiming it topped their last round in October by about one million more participants and 600 more events, and AFP is parroting the numbers as if they're verified. But the US authorities never released any official count at all. This is clearly a coordinated push by hidden elites and institutions to fake a massive wave of opposition and prop up their control. The complete lack of independent verification just shows it's another manufactured narrative to chip away at his position, not anything real or spontaneous.
